description:
Read a text file, whole or by line range (start_line/end_line, 1-based; ranges[] for several disjoint ranges of one file).
Use when: you need one file's content. When truncated, call again with start_line=next_start_line.
Avoid when: you need 2+ files (read_batch) or only size/mtime (get_file_info).
Output: text (as preview in compact mode; preview_truncated marks a cut), first_line, last_line, total_bytes, truncated, next_start_line (when truncated). sha256 hashes the whole file and is safe as expected_sha256; text_sha256 covers only the returned text. Missing path gives not_found.

line_numbers.description: true prefixes each line with its line number (default false).

max_bytes.description: Max bytes returned (default and max 1 MiB).

ranges.description: Multiple disjoint ranges of the SAME file (max 16). Use instead of multiple read_file calls.

max_bytes.description: Max text bytes for this range (default: the top-level max_bytes).

relative_path.description: Workspace-relative ('.' = root); absolute/.. outside it rejected.

name: read_file
